decisions.reason: It fits the firm's core spraying and coating competence and industrial customer base, and despite being a niche system its recent launch makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.
As a low-pressure injection pump close to the established offer and highlighted with its own page, it is a natural portfolio extension that the firm would normally continue supporting.
A material transfer pump line with several models suggests a meaningful product-family investment in the firm's core application equipment business, so a near-term exit is unlikely.

Fire protection flow monitoring supports the firm's move toward more future-oriented and interoperable customer solutions, so even if somewhat more adjacent than pumps it is still likely to be retained.
